doc: The NEUTRAL OBSERVATION the decision server reads: one plain object per game per seat, integers and booleans only. Every group is an object keyed by its field names in the order listed. Field kinds: bool = a flag; int = a plain integer (a table index, a tile index, a count, a price); city = one of THIS seat's living cities named by its CENTRE tile, -1 where none. Emitters: gpu/core/neutral.py (GPU).

buy: the city holding the cheapest completable gold-buyable building
the treasury clears its price plus the peace-gold reserve
a gold settler buy is affordable and the spawn city has the pop
a gold military unit buy is open (under 2x cities, a candidate type)
a gold tile buy is open
Monumentality: a faith builder buy is open
Monumentality: a faith settler buy is open
where a bought unit spawns: the capital, else the first living city
a faith worship-building buy is open
a faith missionary buy is open
a faith apostle buy is open
a faith inquisitor buy is open
a faith warrior monk buy is open
a levy is open and the seat is at war with a major
a faith naturalist buy is open
a faith rock band buy is open
a faith class-building buy is open (Valletta)
the building's table index, -1 where none
a faith land combat unit buy is open
the unit type index, -1 where none
a faith Great Person patronage is open
a gold Great Person patronage is open
a gold district buy is open
a faith district buy is open
route: the origin city of the trade route this seat would open
its destination: a CENTRE tile, or -(2 + city-state index); -1 where none
nuke: the WMD device index a silo would launch, -1 where none
